name: Acetaia Extravecchio Traditional Balsamic DOP
description:
Leonardi Balsamic Vinegar was born in the hills of Modena where the typical grape varieties of Lambrusco and Trebbiano are grown to obtain the grape must that is transformed into one of the world's great delicacies. There is good balsamic vinegar, and there is Traditional Balsamic Vinegar. The former is very good, the latter is in a different league. Pure grape must is reduced, fermented & aged in a series of wood barrels until it has the flavor, texture & aroma to achieve Traditional status. There is no substitude for time, and no short cuts in the process. This Extravecchio (extra aged) DOP vinegar is the grand daddy of them all.

Aged a minimum of 25 years, it is nothing short of sublime. It has the perfect balance of sweet & sour, with a velvet texture that can be poured drop by drop. This is an occasion vinegar - perfect to drizzle on grilled vegetables, aged cheeses, cured meats, or fresh berries. For the purest enjoyment, pour a few drops into a spoon and enjoy!

name: Acetaia Leonardi Traditional Balsamic DOP
description: Leonardi Balsamic Vinegar was born in the hills of Modena where the typical grape varieties of Lambrusco and Trebbiano are grown to obtain the grape must that is transformed into one of the world's great delicacies. There is good balsamic vinegar, and there is Traditional Balsamic Vinegar. The former is very good, the latter is in a different league. Pure grape must is reduced, fermented & aged in a series of wood barrels until it has the flavor, texture & aroma to achieve Traditional status. There is no substitude for time, and no short cuts in the process. This particular vinegar is aged a minimum of 12 years. It has the perfect balance of sweet & sour, with a velvet texture that can be poured drop by drop. In short, it is exquisite. Perfect to drizzle on grilled vegetables, aged cheeses, cured meats, or fresh berries. For the purest enjoyment, pour a few drops into a spoon and enjoy!

name: DeLaurenti Organic Balsamic Vinegar, 250ml
description: Curious about what good balsamic vinegar tastes like, but not ready to drop $50 to find out? This is your answer. And that is why we sell more of this vinegar than any other. Years ago, we wanted to provide our customers with a great balsamic vinegar that wouldn't cost them an arm and a leg. With help from our friends at Ritrovo (local importer of choice), we connected with Maletti, one of the best small producers of balsamic vinegar in Italy. They make more expensive vinegars (which are also available), but none better for the price. This vinegar is to be used without reservation! You won't see the dollars dripping out all over your wild greens - when it's gone, just get more! Nicely balanced and with great viscosity, this vinegar will become a pantry staple!

name: DeLaurenti White Balsamic Vinegar, 250ml
tagline: Kathleen's Favorite! Get some - she has great taste!
description: This is your go to, workhorse white balsamic vinegar. You won't always need it, but when you do, nothing else will do. Tired of staining your mozzarella & burrata for your famous caprese every summer? Those days are over. Get the same great balance of sweet and sour without the hassle. Great for drizzling, marinades and your famous vinaigrette!

name: Villa Manodori Balsamic Vinegar, 250ml
description: Villa Manodori has been one of our best selling balsamic vinegars for years. Once customers taste it's amazing balance of sweet and sour and experience it's silky texture, there is no going back. Made using Trebbiano grape must and red wine vinegar, it is aged for 9 years in a series of oak, chestnut and juniper barrels. It is the perfect accompaniment to fresh greens, grilled vegetables, aged cheese and fresh fruit. Also great for finishing grilled meats and enriching sauces.

name: Villa Manodori Dark Cherry Balsamic, 250ml
description: Villa Manodori produces premium extra virgin olive oils and balsamic vinegars under the guidance of Massimo Bottura, the chef and owner of three-star Michelin restaurant Osteria Francescana in Modena, Italy. Named the world’s best restaurant in 2018, it is the only Italian restaurant ever to hold that title. This balsamic vinegar is made from Trebbiano grapes and red wine vinegar and aged for nine years in barrels made from Vignola cherry wood. Thick and viscous, the balsamic has a refined balance between sweet and tart. Excellent as a glaze for pork and duck, or drizzled over fruit-based desserts.

name: Maletti Balsamic Vinegar, 250ml
description: Curious about what good balsamic vinegar tastes like? This is your answer. Friend and local importer, Ritrovo, helped us out by connecting us with Maletti, one of the best small producers of balsamic vinegar in Italy. Aged in French oak barrels that previously aged wine, this 6 year vinegar has extraordinary density, depth of flavor and a clean, delicate finish. Superb in a wide range of dishes, it is perfect drizzled on fresh berries, on a simple green salad with flakes of Parmigiano-Reggiano, or for finishing grilled meats.

name: Giuseppe Giusti 2 Medals Gold Balsamic, 100ml
description:
More than four centuries have passed since the ancestors of the Giusti family set up the first batteries of wooden barrels in the attic of their house in via Farini in Modena. Today, Giusti Balsamic Vinegars of Modena enhance the dishes of the world’s top chefs and grace the shelves of the most exclusive stores in Italy and around the world.

A classic of the Giusti family, the 2 Gold Medals is a versatile vinegar that is medium in density, with a velvety structure and a delicate, round acidity. It is fresh and fruity, good density, over notes of mature fruits, licorice and black pepper.

name: Giuseppe Giusti 3 Medals Red Balsamic, 100ml
description:
More than four centuries have passed since the ancestors of the Giusti family set up the first batteries of wooden barrels in the attic of their house in via Farini in Modena. Today, Giusti Balsamic Vinegars of Modena enhance the dishes of the world’s top chefs and grace the shelves of the most exclusive stores in Italy and around the world.

This 3 Gold Medal vinegar is viscous and fruity, with a recipe created at the beginning of the 20th centur.The vinegar itself, obtained from sweet, sun dried grapes is dense and sweet - making it perfect for drizzling on buratta, grilled vegetables, pork, chicken & fresh fruit.

name: Giuseppe Giusti 4 Medals Balsamic, 100ml
description:
More than four centuries have passed since the ancestors of the Giusti family set up the first batteries of wooden barrels in the attic of their house in via Farini in Modena. Today, Giusti Balsamic Vinegars of Modena enhance the dishes of the world’s top chefs and grace the shelves of the most exclusive stores in Italy and around the world.

The 4 Gold Medals celebrates the 400 years of the Giusti family production. It's particularly sweet, dense and persistent with a rich aromatic bouquet that derives from the long aging in barrels. The aromas and flavors of plum jam and red fruits intertwine with hints of honey and vanilla. Perfect for drizzling on aged cheeses, pumpkin soup or pasta, red meat, avocados & fresh fruit.

name: Giuseppe Giusti 5 Medals Red Stripe Balsamic, 100ml
description:
More than four centuries have passed since the ancestors of the Giusti family set up the first batteries of wooden barrels in the attic of their house in via Farini in Modena. Today, Giusti Balsamic Vinegars of Modena enhance the dishes of the world’s top chefs and grace the shelves of the most exclusive stores in Italy and around the world.

The 5 Gold Medal Vinegar is the ultimate pride and expression of the art of Giusti vinegars. The "Banda Rossa" was the personal gift from Uncle Giuseppe to family members. This elixir has a robust body and concentration, and is distinguished by its extraordinary complexity and rich bouquet of aromas.It features notes of black cherries and sweet spices, with marked fragrances of the ancient woods in which it aged. Try it on fresh berries, aged cheeses, risotto, eggs or even in a cocktail!

name: Giuseppe Giusti White Balsamic Glaze, 150ml
description:
More than four centuries have passed since the ancestors of the Giusti family set up the first batteries of wooden barrels in the attic of their house in via Farini in Modena. Today, Giusti Balsamic Vinegars of Modena enhance the dishes of the world’s top chefs and grace the shelves of the most exclusive stores in Italy and around the world.

This white balsamic cream is a versatile condiment obtained solely from white grapes. It is fresh and mildly sweet, with fruity and floral notes.Perfect to drizzle on fresh vegetables, fruit and seafood.

name: Giuseppe Giusti White Balsamic Vinegar, 100ml
description:
More than four centuries have passed since the ancestors of the Giusti family set up the first batteries of wooden barrels in the attic of their house in via Farini in Modena. Today, Giusti Balsamic Vinegars of Modena enhance the dishes of the world’s top chefs and grace the shelves of the most exclusive stores in Italy and around the world.

This White Balsamic Dressing is made from sweet raw juice pressed delicately from Trebbiano grapes, then combined with white wine vinegar and aged in French oak and ash casks. This process preserves all the fruity and floral aromas of the grapes, resulting in a condiment with low acidity and notes of sweet yellow fruits and dried citrus. Perfect for dressings, seafood & even cocktails!

name: Ottavi Clementine Vinegar, 250ml
description: This vinegar is amazing. Made with candied & fresh clementines, organic spirit vinegar & unrefined cane sugar, it is zesty, intense, and tangy. Ideal on shellfish, as a deglazing agent for poultry, or to give a boost to your summer vinaigrettes!

name: Ottavi Fig Vinegar, 250ml
description: Like it's Clementine Orange cousin, this vinegar is unique, smooth and spirited. It is fruity & lightly sweet with a subtle, pleasant aroma. Made solely from fresh, ripe figs from Ottavi's orchards, 8% organic spirit vinegar and unrefined cane sugar, it is perfect for deglazing poultry, as an accompaniment for foie gras & of course salads.

name: Acetaia Leonardi 3 Yr Balsamic, 250ml
description: Leonardi has been producing balsamic vinegar for 4 generations. Dark brown and velvety, this versatile condiment has an amazing balance of sweet and sour. Use this for an amazing salad dressing, or drizzle it on aged cheeses, fresh berries or grilled vegetables.

name: Acetaia Leonardi Aceto Balsamico di Modena IGP Gold Seal, 250mL
description:
Acetaia Leonardi's Francobolli Series (francobolli means "postage stamps") is a selection of three I.G.P. Balsamic Vinegars and a Condimento Balsamico Bianco. With attractive labels that look like vintage postage stamps, this range of vinegars satisfies every balsamic need in the kitchen. Adhering to I.G.P. regulations, Acetaia Leonardi identifies the age and viscosity of their vinegars with a proprietary symbol—coins—with each coin representing approximately 2 years of aging.

Leonardi's Sigillo Oro is a careful blend of very dense cooked grape must and high quality wine vinegar. This vinegar is lightly pungent with aromas of oak and cherry with a long, bright, sweet finish.

Drizzle over prosciutto and figs, sliced figs with gorgonzola and walnuts, or any salumi platter. Ideal over a tuna or beef tartare. Drizzle over thinly sliced roast beef or pork roast. Perfect over baked apples, stone fruit, cheese cake, gelato and panna cotta.

name: Acetaia Leonardi Aceto Balsamico di Modena IGP Red Seal, 250mL
description:
Acetaia Leonardi's Francobolli Series (francobolli means "postage stamps") is a selection of three I.G.P. Balsamic Vinegars and a Condimento Balsamico Bianco. With attractive labels that look like vintage postage stamps, this range of vinegars satisfies every balsamic need in the kitchen. Adhering to I.G.P. regulations, Acetaia Leonardi identifies the age and viscosity of their vinegars with a proprietary symbol—coins—with each coin representing approximately 2 years of aging.

Leonardi's Sigillo Rosso is a careful blend of cooked grape must and high quality wine vinegar. Enjoy aromas of fresh raspberries and a lively acidic finish. Use for all types of salads, dressings, and marinades. Deglaze any roasting pan and brush onto grilled meats. Perfect poured on peak-season tomatoes.

name: Acetaia Leonardi Aceto Balsamico di Modena IGP Silver Seal, 250mL
description:
Acetaia Leonardi's Francobolli Series (francobolli means "postage stamps") is a selection of three I.G.P. Balsamic Vinegars and a Condimento Balsamico Bianco. With attractive labels that look like vintage postage stamps, this range of vinegars satisfies every balsamic need in the kitchen. Adhering to I.G.P. regulations, Acetaia Leonardi identifies the age and viscosity of their vinegars with a proprietary symbol "coins" with each coin representing approximately 2 years of aging.

Leonardi's Sigillo Argento is a masterful blend of cooked grape must and high quality wine vinegar. Thick as maple syrup, with notes of cooked grapes like a good Amarone, and a long subtle acidic finish.

Drizzle over a sizzling hot grilled steak or pork chop, as well as on grilled eggplant, peppers, mushrooms, and zucchini. Wonderful swirled into butternut squash soup or creamy Parmigiano risotto. Highlight the freshness of freshly sliced plums, nectarines, and peaches. Use instead of caramel or chocolate sauce over baked pears and apples.

name: Acetaia Leonardi Saba Mosto d'Uva Cotto, 250mL
description: The premier balsamic vinegars come from Modena, and Acetaia Leonardi is a classic producer. The fourth-generation family-owned operation grows their own Lambrusco and Trebbiano grapes for their award-winning line of vinegars. Their Saba is a thick syrup made from cooking grape must (freshly crushed grape juice with all the skins, seeds and stems) down in copper kettles until it’s reduced by two-thirds. It’s then aged for two years. What emerges is a fruit-forward syrup, the essence of grapes, if you will, and is redolent of raisins and Italian plums. Use as you would any balsamic reduction; drizzled over meats, fish, chicken, cheese, berries, and stone fruit.

name: Acetaia Leonardi White Balsamic, 100ml
description: The premier balsamic vinegars come from Modena, and Acetaia Leonardi is a classic producer. The fourth-generation family-owned operation grows their own Lambrusco and Trebbiano grapes for their award-winning line of vinegars. Their Balsamico Bianco is made with Trebbiano grapes, blended with Italian white wine vinegar, and aged in wood barrels for four years. The all-purpose vinegar has citrus and pear notes and a good balance of acidic tartness and fruity sweetness. Use this in salad dressings and sauces.

name: Acetaia Leonardi Whitle Balsamic
description: The premier balsamic vinegars come from Modena, and Acetaia Leonardi is a classic producer. The fourth-generation family-owned operation grows their own Lambrusco and Trebbiano grapes for their award-winning line of vinegars. Their Balsamico Bianco is made with Trebbiano grapes, blended with Italian white wine vinegar, and aged in wood barrels for four years. The all-purpose vinegar has citrus and pear notes and a good balance of acidic tartness and fruity sweetness. Use this in salad dressings and sauces.

name: Leonardi Crema all' Aceto Balsamico di Modena IGP, 100ml
description: The premier balsamic vinegars come from Modena, and Acetaia Leonardi is a classic producer. The fourth-generation family-owned operation grows their own Lambrusco and Trebbiano grapes for their award-winning line of balsamic vinegars. Their Crema, or glaze, is a balsamic reduction made by cooking down grape must (freshly crushed grape juice with all the skins, seeds and stems) until it has the consistency of syrup, then blending it with their aged balsamic vinegar. The glaze is sweet and tangy and is exceptional drizzled on nearly anything: cheese, meats, roasted vegetables, even ice-cream.

name: La Vecchia Dispensa 30 yr Anniversary Balsamic, 100ml
description: La Vecchia Dispensa started as a family restaurant in Modena in 1973. Since the 1980s, however, they have been wholly dedicated to the production of fine balsamic vinegar. This amazing vinegar was created to commemorate La Vecchia's 30th anniversary. Dense & syrupy, it has an intensely sweet flavor profile that is the result of the grape must being cooked down further before being transfered to wood barrels for aging and fermentation. It is perfect for salad dressing, or for drizzling drop by drop over shards of Parmigiano-Reggiano, fresh berries, grilled meats or even ice cream.

name: La Vecchia Dispensa Apple and Citrus Balsamic, 100ml
description: La Vecchia Dispensa started as a family restaurant in Modena in 1973. Since the 1980s, however, they have been wholly dedicated to the production of fine balsamic vinegar. Their Condimento Balsamic is truly a unique product. Made with 60% apple syrup, 30% balsamic vinegar, 10% acacia honey & fresh citrus rind, it is at once sweet, sour & fruity. Velvety in texture, it makes a perfect dessert topping. Try drizzling it on fresh ricotta, ice cream or seasonal berries.

name: La Vecchia Dispensa Foglia Rosa Balsamic, 250ml
description: La Vecchia Dispensa started as a family restaurant in Modena in 1973. Since the 1980s, however, they have been wholly dedicated to the production of fine balsamic vinegar. Their Foglia Rossa Balsamic is a Gold Medal winner at the USI Vinegar 2024 Competition. It has an intense fresh acidity with mature red fruit notes, making it ideal with cold dishes, grilled vegetables & eggs. Aromas of oak, cherry & chestnut on the palate define this award winning vinegar.

name: La Vecchia Dispensa Foglia Verde Balsamic, 250ml
description: La Vecchia Dispensa started as a family restaurant in the town of Castelvetr, near Modena in 1973. Since the 1980s, however, they have been wholly dedicated to the production of fine balsamic vinegar. Their Foglia Verde vinegar is a versatile blend with the perfect balance of sweetness and acidity. If there were an official price/quality index for balsamic, this vinegar would score in the upper right hand corner. Use it liberally on everything from salads to fresh berries.

name: La Vecchia Dispensa Foglia Viola Balsamic, 250ml
description:
La Vecchia Dispensa started as a family restaurant in Modena in 1973. Since the 1980s, however, they have been wholly dedicated to the production of fine balsamic vinegar.

Violet Label Balsamic Vinegar of Modena IGP is a vinegar with a fine aromatic structure. The consistency is moderately syrupy, and its medium density makes it perfect for everything from grilled vegetables to white meats and fish.

Perfect for those who appreciate a vinegar that is not too sweet, but no less intense. Like any high-quality Balsamic Vinegar, it is characterized by an elegant aromatic bouquet, the result of aging in barrels of fine woods. It has lovely fruity notes of cherry and mulberry, with pleasant hints of vanilla from the oak and acacia.

name: La Vecchia Dispensa Nobili Sapori Balsamic, 250ml
description: La Vecchia Dispensa started as a family restaurant in Modena in 1973. Since the 1980s, however, they have been wholly dedicated to the production of fine balsamic vinegar. Their Nobili Sapori Balsamic is a blend of cooked grape must and wine vinegar that has been aged for 5 years in a variety of wooden barrels. Bright and tangy, it is a great value that is perfect for salad dressing, recipes and marinades.

name: La Vecchia Dispensa Organic Balsamic, 250ml
description: La Vecchia Dispensa started as a family restaurant in Modena in 1973. Since the 1980s, however, they have been wholly dedicated to the production of fine balsamic vinegar. Their Organic Balsamic is a blend of cooked grape must and high quality aged wine vinegar. It has a balanced sweet & sour character with a bright and fruity finish. Use it on salads, grilled vegetables or reduce on the stove for a glaze to finish grilled meats or fish.

name: Calogiuri Fig Vincotto, 250ml
description: This unique condiment is made from grape must aged four years in wood barrels. Figs are added during the third year of aging, giving the vinegar a balanced sweet and tart complexity. Use it for salad dressing, finishing grilled meats and vegetables, with fresh cheese, or even drizzle over ice cream.

name: Elsa 12 yr Balsamic Vinegar, 250ml
description: This classic vinegar is made from the ancient Lambrusco grape varieties - Maestri, Salamino, and Sorbara. Careful and lengthy aging in cherry, chestnut, acacia, oak and juniper barrels imparts a rich, complex flavor and a velvety texture. Perfect for salad dressing, drizzling on fresh strawberries, and roasted meats.

name: Elsa 6 yr Balsamic Vinegar, 250ml
description: This classic vinegar is the starter version of it's older sibling. Made from the same ancient Lambrusco grape varieties - Maestri, Salamino, and Sorbara. Careful and lengthy aging in cherry, chestnut, acacia, oak and juniper barrels imparts a rich, balanced blend of sweet & sour. Perfect for salad dressing & marinades.

name: Fini Balsamic Vinegar, 250ml
description: Fini Balsamic of Modena has been on our shelves for a long time, and for good reason. If quality is on the X axis and cost is on the Y axis, this vinegar scores in the upper right corner. Great for salad dressing, marinades & even drizzling on aged cheeses & fresh berries - all without seeing the dollars pouring out of the spout with the vinegar!

name: Ciacco Barolo Wine Vinegar, 250ml
description: From the heart of Piemonte terroir comes this rich, ruby-colored red wine vinegar that is produced in Modena by an Acetaia that specializes in monovarietal vinegars, voted #1 monovarietal vinegar in Italy by Gambero Rosso and made from 100% DOCG Barolo Nebbiolo grapes. This exceptional wine vinegar is a perfect condiment for salads, meat dishes, polenta, and braised meats. Savory and smooth, it will become a go-to item in your kitchen.

name: Prelibato White Balsamic Vinegar, 200ml
description: For its Prelibato, (white balsamic condiment), Acetaia Malpighi uses the best part of the grape - the “Trebbiano Modenese." These grapes are crushed softly and slowly, resulting in a juice that is transparent. The juice is then filtered and placed in a centrifuge to make it dense without being cooked. Lastly, it is aged in ash wood for up to 5 years to obtain its delicate aroma and retain its clear color. What does this mean to you? It means that your get to enjoy an amazing, transparent balsamic vinegar on your pork, salads, fresh mozzarella, cured meats and fresh berries.

name: Ritrovo Selections Apricot Balsamic Vinegar, 200ml
description: This Apricot Balsamic is made from ripe apricots, and organic grape must, resulting in a balanced vinegar with an intense apricot flavor and notes of almond, lemon peel, and orange blossom that is reminiscent of Italian summers. The bright acidity complements its rich flavor and subtle sweetness creating a versatile product that has varied culinary applications. This vinegar makes an excellent glaze for poultry, especially chicken, Cornish game hen and squab, as well as pork or veal. Its brightness also lends itself well to traditional salad dressings, grilled fruit, and cream-based desserts, such as semifreddo, panna cotta and zabaione.

name: Ritrovo Selections Blood Orange Balsamic Vinegar, 200ml
description:
Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality.

Enjoy the bold flavor of Sicily’s famous ‘Tarocco’ winter blood oranges year-round. Crafted by vinegar master Nicolo Verrini, this white balsamic blends real Sicilian blood orange juice with white grape must for a bright, balanced taste. Perfect on salads, duck confit, roasted squash, or to deglaze meat dishes.

name: Ritrovo Selections Mediterranean Herb Balsamic, 200ml
description:
Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality.

With a brilliant green color and aromatic flavors of Italian basil and fresh rosemary combined with sweet white grape, this balsamic vinegar is a perfectly balanced condiment for salads, ceviches, pickling, and even mixology.

name: Ritrovo Selections Organic Apple Balsamic Vinegar, 200ml
description: Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality. Their Organic Apple Balsamic Vinegar is made from tart, organic Trentino apples and organic Modena grape must. The agrodolce (agro=sour; dolce=sweet) vinegar has good balance and a rich flavor. It blends beautifully with fruity olive oils from Southern Italy.

name: Ritrovo Selections Organic Citrus Balsamic Vinegar, 200ml
description: Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality. Their Organic Citrus Balsamic Vinegar is a lively balsamic vinegar inspired by foods of the Amalfi Coast. It’s made with lemon juice, Trebbiano grape must and wine vinegar. Excellent in garden salads, on seafood, or drizzled over ripe berries.

name: Ritrovo Selections Organic Tomato Balsamic, 200ml
description: Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality. Their Organic Tomato Balsamic Vinegar captures the essence of the harvest in an invigorating sweet and savory vinegar. Made in Italy with juice extracted from tomatoes at peak ripeness and white grape must before being aged in wood, this vinegar will surprise you with its nuanced flavor. Excellent drizzled over caprese salads or on grilled halibut.

name: Ritrovo Selections Organic Turmeric Balsamic, 200ml
description: Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality. Their organic white balsamic with turmeric is truely unique. A SOFI Best New Product Award Winner, it strikes the perfect balance of sweet and mild bitterness with a lovely aromatic quality.

name: Regalis Cabernet Vinegar, 250ml
description: Brewed in Catalonia, Spain, this cabernet sauvignon vinegar carries deep notes of mature red fruits and chocolate. Made using the Schutzenbach method for acetification, this vinegar is as much an expression of terroir as the wine it came from. It has a balanced acidity, a sweet undertone, and a long finish. It rounds out a hearty beef stew beautifully, makes for a delectable reduction in a sweet application, and mixes into a terrific cocktail.

name: Regalis Chardonnay Vinegar, 250ml
description: Evocative of honey, citrus, and sunshine, this chardonnay vinegar is bursting with depth. Brewed from carefully sourced chardonnay wine, the brightness in this vinegar is mellowed by a hint of sweetness and a savory minerality. Several years of aging in our cellars lend this vinegar a full and dynamic mouthfeel. It heightens any seafood dish, whether a delicate hiramasa crudo or a lightly poached halibut filet, and shines in quick pickles or even behind the bar!

name: Regalis Cider Vinegar, 250ml
description: While the cider of northern Spain is revered in its own right, the vinegar it produces is equally bright and complex. Made with the famed Schutzenbach method, this apple cider vinegar mellows in acidity as it ages to offer a full bouquet of apple aromatics suggestive of almonds, cooked fruit, and spices. Needless to say, it is perfect for seasoning apples in sweet or savory applications, but will also instantly transform a pot of braised pork shoulder. It makes an easy natural tonic, too, when diluted with still or sparkling water.

name: Regalis Pedro Ximenez Vinegar, 250ml
description: For hundreds of years, Pedro Ximenez grapes have been dried under the Spanish sun and concentrated to produce a dessert wine. The vinegar produced from this wine shares these sweet, syrupy characteristics but is balanced by a delightful acidity and a long, full finish. This vinegar shines where a balsamic might, but is less sweet and offers more minerality. Consider using it drizzled over ice cream or fresh berries, or in a stonefruit salad with freshly pulled mozzarella.

name: Regalis Rose Wine Vinegar, 250ml
description: A versatile vinegar to be kept on the counter at all times, this rosé wine vinegar can be used universally wherever a balanced hit of acidity is required. Made from small production tempranillo wine using the Schutzenbach acetification method, it maintains floral notes of bright red berries and bittersweet fruit. While it pairs perfectly with summer vegetables and winter’s leafy greens, it also shines in a mignonette for oysters or used in a quick pickle.

name: VR Aceti Lambrusco Vinegar, 250ml
description: Another great product from our good firends at Ritrovo Selections. Made by VR Aceti in Emilia Romagna, this vinegar is flavorful, full-bodied and complex. Made from 100% Lambrusco grapes, it is great for beef dishes, salads and marinades.

name: VR Aceti Trebbiano White Wine Vinegar, 250ml
description: Made by VR Aceti in Emilia Romagna, this vinegar is crisp and lively. Made from Trebbiano and Sauvignon Blanc grapes, is it perfect for salads, marinades and ceviche.

name: Boulou Cabernet Verjus Rouge, 750ml
description:
A classic condiment that dates back to ancient Rome, Verjus is the juice that’s made from the pressing of unripe grapes. Although similar to vinegar, Verjus it’s not acetified so it’s gentler and milder, not as acidic and with an added natural sweetness. And unlike wine, it’s not fermented so it doesn’t have any alcohol content.

Cabernet Verjus by Boulou is made from Cabernet wine grapes, beautifully red, sweet and fruity, with a well-balanced acidity. Use it to add a sweet-tart flavor and a deeper taste to recipes that would be overwhelmed by the tartness of vinegar - dressing, glaces, and even poaching fruit. This red wine verjus is perfect to soften the flavor of bitter greens like Arugula, or to add flavor to sauces and marinades for meats.

name: DeLouis Cider Vinegar, 500ml
description: DeLouis cider vinegar, also known as apple cider vinegar, is made from fermented apple juice. It is a popular ingredient in many cuisines and is widely used in cooking, pickling, and salad dressings. Cider vinegar has a pale amber color and a tangy, fruity flavor with a subtle sweetness. It is known for its mild, delicate taste, making it a popular choice for dishes where a strong vinegar flavor is overwhelming. It can be used to add flavor to a variety of dishes, including salads, marinades, sauces, and stews.

name: Pojer e Sandri Quince Wine Vinegar, 250ml
description:
Pojer e Sandri's single-fruit vinegars are in a class of their own. After carefully selecting fruit from the orchards of family, friends, and select farmers in the area, Pojer e Sandri gently press the fruit and inoculate the juice with yeast to ferment.

After reaching the desired sugar content, the fermented juice is placed in oak barrels containing some of the vinegar "mother." Depending on the fruit, the aging process might take anywhere from 18 to 24 months for the right balance of acidity and fruitiness to be achieved.

Quince's delicate aroma makes it perfectly suited for seafood such as poached halibut or sautéed scallops. Drizzle over tender greens or a tropical fruit salad made with mango and papaya.

name: Pojer e Sandri White Wine Vinegar, 250ml
description:
Pojer e Sandri crafts their White Wine Vinegar using a blend of local Dolomiti white grape varietals such as Riesling, Kerner, Incrocio Manzoni, Sauvignon, and Pinto Bianco. The resulting vinegar features aromatic floral notes of elderflower blossoms, acacia, and citrus zest, grounded by strong mineral notes that harken to the Dolomites' famous volcanic cliffs.

Ideal for use in making a lively mayonnaise; salad dressings for delicate and tender greens such as mache, lettuces, endives and frisee; and for pickling and preserving vegetables to make a giardiniera. This white wine vinegar will add a sparkle of brightness to any recipe calling for white wine.

name: American Vinegar Works 19.53 "Miles from the Tree Cider" Vinegar, 250ml
description: Made with apple cider from northern Massachusetts this Apple Cider Vinegar is a tribute to Johnny Appleseed who was born exactly 19.53 miles from vinegar works and is credited with spreading (apple cider!) apple trees. ACW thinks their former neighbor would really appreciate what they have done with his orchards and be smitten by this slightly sweet and highly tangy small-batch New England Apple Cider Vinegar.

name: American Vinegar Works Chardonnay Vinegar, 250ml
description: Made with chardonnay from California this vinegar would be a blanc de blancs if it were a champagne. Luckily it is not, it is better. It is slow fermented in small batches using a unique process from the early 1800s and aged in 25-gallon American oak barrels.

name: American Vinegar Works Honey Vinegar, 250ml
description: Honey wine, also known as mead, is an alcoholic beverage made by fermenting honey with water, sometimes with added fruits, spices, or herbs. With a rich history dating back to Viking and medieval times, it offers a sweet and aromatic drinking experience.The honey notes are unmistakable in this barrel-aged, limited-edition vinegar that has a warm, hazy honeycomb glow from the unfiltered and raw honey. Made with mead from Vermont and finished with raw clover honey after barrel aging!

name: American Vinegar Works Hot Cider Vinegar, 250ml
description: A truly unique vinegar and one of our favorites. This Apple Cider Hot Vinegar is made by co-fermenting local apple cider with a mix of fruit, spices, and peppers. It will start with a slightly smoky or bacon flavor followed by a savory note and, finally, just a touch of heat. This is not a hot sauce but a one-of-a-kind vinegar that you can add to nearly everything!

name: American Vinegar Works IPA Malt Vinegar, 250ml
description: Made from a Massachusetts craft IPA this vinegar is malty and tangy leaving you with a slight mouth water finish from the hops. It is slow fermented in small batches using a unique process from the early 1800s and aged in 25-gallon American oak barrels. This IPA Beer Malt Vinegar is the ultimate vinegar for fish and chips.

name: American Vinegar Works Maple Cider Vinegar, 250ml
description: Made with apple cider from northern Massachusetts and organic Vermont maple syrup from Runamok this vinegar perfectly balances sour and sweet to produce a beautifully toffeed cider vinegar. A little bit of fall in New England captured in a bottle!

name: American Vinegar Works Red Wine Vinegar, 250ml
description: Made with California Shiraz (or Syrah) this vinegar is a bold standout that will quickly become your go-to red wine vinegar for your most versatile vinaigrettes. This vinegar was co-fermented in small batches using a unique process from the early 1800s and aged in 25 gallon American oak barrels. This is one of the best red wine vinegars you can find.

name: American Vinegar Works Rice Wine Vinegar, 250ml
description: Made with junmai-grade sake from California this rice wine vinegar is elegant and has more weight than commercial vinegars. It is slow fermented in small batches using a unique process from the early 1800s and aged in 25-gallon American oak barrels. A perfect partner for your micro greens, cucumbers, and any other dish where you would use an expressive rice wine vinegar.

name: American Vinegar Works Rose Vinegar, 250ml
description: Made with California rose wine this vinegar is bright, summery, and, frankly, beautiful. It is slow fermented in small batches using a unique process from the early 1800s and aged in 25-gallon American oak barrels. Lighter than a red wine vinegar but with more body than a white wine vinegar.

name: Castello di Volpaia Red Wine Vinegar, 250ml
description: Produced in the cellars of a medieval village in the Chianti hills of Tuscany, Castello di Volpaia's aged red wine vinegar is produced from carefully selected wines of the region. These unique vinegars are produced using the "truciolo" method: the wine is percolated through "trucioli" (natural wood chips), transforming the natural alcohol of the wine into the acetic acid of vinegar while enhancing the wine's complex bouquet. After this, the vinegar is allowed to age in oak and chestnut barrels for another 10 to 12 months. The result is an intense, aromatic vinegar of exceptional roundness, with a rich flavor that enhances foods from salads to meats and berries. A little sediment in the bottom of the bottle is a natural byproduct of the process and will not detract from the qualities of the vinegar.

name: Castello di Volpaia White Wine Vinegar, 250ml
description: Produced in the cellars of a medieval village in the Chianti hills of Tuscany, Castello di Volpaia's aged white wine vinegar is produced from carefully selected wines of the region. These unique vinegars are produced using the "truciolo" method: the wine is percolated through "trucioli" (natural wood chips), transforming the natural alcohol of the wine into the acetic acid of vinegar while enhancing the wine's complex bouquet. The result is an intense, bright vinegar with a rich flavor that enhances everything from salads to meats to fresh greens. Made with Trebbiano and Malvasia wine.

name: Castello di Volpaia White Wine Vinegar, 500ml
description: Produced in the cellars of a medieval village in the Chianti hills of Tuscany, Castello di Volpaia's aged white wine vinegar is produced from carefully selected wines of the region. These unique vinegars are produced using the "truciolo" method: the wine is percolated through "trucioli" (natural wood chips), transforming the natural alcohol of the wine into the acetic acid of vinegar while enhancing the wine's complex bouquet. The result is an intense, bright vinegar with a rich flavor that enhances everything from salads to meats to fresh greens. Made with Trebbiano and Malvasia wine.

name: El Majuelo Pedro Ximenez Sherry Vinegar, 250ml
description:
This sweet sherry vinegar is produced using the Pedro Ximénez grape. The grapes are left on the vine longer than usual, increasing the residual sugars and ultimately producing a sweet vinegar. The grapes are pressed and aged in American Oak barrels for at least 2 years. The result is an exquisite sweet and sour vinegar with a lower acidity.

El Majuelo is a family-run company in Jerez, Spain. Joaquin’s family has been making sherry vinegar in Jerez for 4 generations. A trained winemaker and cellarmaster, Joaquin took over the business from his father. He uses traditional criaderas and soleras process of transferring vinegars from barrel to barrel over a period of many years, giving the vinegars their unique character. El Majuelo is known as one of the top artisan sherry producers in the region.

name: El Majuelo Sherry Vinegar, 750ml
description:
This dark amber sherry vinegar is smooth and light-bodied. Made from 100% Palomina Fina grapes and aged six months, it is complex, with notes of fig, almond, and oak tempering the bright acidity of the vinegar.

El Majuelo is known as one of the top artisan sherry producers in the region.

name: L'Estornell Garnacha Red Wine Vinegar, 250ml
description: Produced in the southern region of Priorato in Catalonia, this vinegar is made exclusively from Garnacha grapes and then aged in oak barrels for at least 20 years. Ruby in color, L'Estornell Garnacha Red Wine Vinegar is bright and aromatic, making it perfect for a classic vinaigrette.

name: Sanchez Romate Sherry Vinegar, 375ml
description: Aged for at least three years in oak, this vinegar is mildly sweet and bright with hints of almonds. It's unique character can be attributed to the location where it is made (soil and proximity to the ocean), and the solera process by which it is aged. Throughout aging, the vinegar is transferred from oak barrel to oak barrel, all the while being mixed with wines of varied ages. This process provides layers of complexity and an unrivaled balance between sweetness and acidity. The result is a vinegar that is famously amazing with tomatoes, in dressings & for marinating.

name: Ximenez-Spinola Vinegar En Rama,
description:
Ximénez-Spínola is a small, independent family winery, a specialist in wine & vinegar products exclusively from Pedro Ximénez grapes. They put all their effort into the quality of its production, which guarentees each bottle of wine or vinegar is the full expression of their efforts.

This vinegar is the result of a wonderful mistake, the consequence of a natural process where the work of the yeasts known as "mycoderma" converted the Pedro Ximenez raisins into vinegar. The resulting vinegar is then obtained directly from the barrel. Bottled "En Rama" means that the vinegar is bottled unfiltered and in the same conditions in which it is taken directly from the cask without undergoing any further treatment, therefore maintaining all the aromas and flavours. This is an intensely acetic vinegar of great intensity and elegance, with the sweetness characteristic of the Pedro Ximenez variety.

name: Banyuls Vinegar, 500ml
description: This vinegar comes from the French seaside town of Banyuls, home to one of France's great wines of the same name. Aged in oak barrels for 5 years, Banyuls is uncommonly smooth. It has distinct aromas of walnut, spice, vanilla and licorice. Its nutty flavor profile makes it the perfect ingredient for vinaigrettes made with hazelnut or walnut oil. It's also great for deglazing - as it adds a balanced acidity to duck, game and foie gras.

name: Beaufor Champagne Vinegar, 500ml
description: It makes sense that Champagne makes good vinegar. It also makes sense that the resulting vinegar shares some of the same flavor and aromatic qualities of Champagne. With a slight hint of vanilla and a delicate and uniquely toasty bouquet, it is perfect for vinaigrettes and sauces. Imported from the heart of the Champagne region of France.

name: Beaufor Red Wine Vinegar, 500ml
description: This is the everyday red wine vinegar that you need to keep at the ready. Aged in oak barrels for 2 months, it is round, clean, woodsy and bright. Perfect for vinaigrettes and marinades.

name: Beaufor White Wine Vinegar, 500ml
description: An everyday vinegar made by a respected French company. This white wine vinegar is bright, clean and aromatic. Perfect for a classic French vinaigrette with mince shallots, egg yolk, dijon and extra virgin olive oil.

name: A L'Olivier Passion Fruit Vinegar, 200ml
description: In 1822, Monsieur Popelin, a pharmacist, set up a shop devoted to olive oil in Paris and A L'Olivier was born. Today, the family owned company still makes amazing olive oil, along with high quality vinegars and nut oils. This vinegar is simultaneously fresh, sour and smooth. Use it instead of lemon juice to finish grilled fish, or toss with a variety of fresh fruits.

name: A L'Olivier Raspberry Infused Vinegar, 200ml
description: In 1822, Monsieur Popelin, a pharmacist, set up a shop devoted to olive oil in Paris and A L'Olivier was born. Today, the family owned company still makes amazing olive oil, along with high quality vinegars and nut oils. A combination of intensely fruity, acidic raspberry and vinegar, this product is the ideal way to deglaze duck breasts, veal or chicken. Blend with hazelnut or olive oil in a salad with fennel, arugula and roasted hazelnuts. You can even stir it into sparkling water for a nonalcoholic cocktail.

name: Bragg's Apple Cider Vinegar, 16oz
description: Made from delicious, healthy, organically grown apples, this vinegar has a multitude of uses. Full of sweet acidity, it’s a wholesome way to add delicious flavor to salad dressings, sauces and marinades veggies.

name: Grosoli Cream with Balsamic Vinegar of Modena, 250ml
description: A reduction is only as good as the balsamic used. Sweet and savory, this thick, aromatic balsamic cream is ready to beautifully finish grilled meat and fish, salads, pasta and risotto.
